claims.expected_direction: Curry has a substantially stronger supplied-shooting case; Barnes can have useful short touch without comparable perimeter execution.
claims.required_conditions: Compare same available shot/mode, distance, pressure and preparation; keep opportunity share distinct.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Curry S08 is inferred, Barnes catch split mixed-mode; role/health/sample and uncertainty prevent a precise margin or universal points ordering.

claims.expected_direction: Support strong on-ball craft and possession protection at matched exposure without requiring elite ability in every pass family.
claims.required_conditions: Fix pressure/time, creator role and available targets; separate handling losses from other turnovers.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Team infrastructure and defensive liability limit broader value; aggregate suppression does not prove each loss mechanism. Curry source-unknown S17 control cannot establish a named security ranking.

claims.expected_direction: Express exceptional reachable rim coverage and contest capacity when positioned/available; preserve more limited space-switching and unfinished offense.
claims.required_conditions: Declare start, responsibility, approach/release geometry, arrival, health and legal-control assumptions; inspect access versus execution.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: H1/jump/motion and S45 controls are not measured; late/away/unreachable cases need not yield a contest. Do not require him to dominate every switch or finish.

claims.expected_direction: Support skilled receiving/short touch and useful lob decisions/delivery when the option exists, without requiring fast unencumbered motion.
claims.required_conditions: Supply relevant possession/window and receiver; select actual short-touch finish for that question, not only a dunk.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Historical examples selected, bad-series/support debate retained, pairs share evidence. Equal grades do not prove isolated read/placement equality. Broad passing rankings omit post/hub contexts.

claims.expected_direction: Preserve a credible supplied perimeter outlet and rim-protection contribution alongside the source drop-coverage concern.
claims.required_conditions: Separate open catch, contest and drop-role tasks; hold unsupported release/movement/positioning attribution explicit.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Catch split and wide S36 are hypotheses; same source credits more speed than Zubac, not an absolute test or specific lateral measure. Do not penalize technique and physical speed independently from poor-drop label.

claims.expected_direction: Support guard/wing containment, assigned secondary help and short scoring without demanding elite perimeter shooting.
claims.required_conditions: Compare matched noncenter/helper responsibilities, starting positions and opportunities before changing role.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Attention/navigation/motion and full-time-center requirements are not established by versatility; weak jumper and lead-scoring ceiling retained.

claims.expected_direction: Full movement-created offense cannot be inferred from supplied movement-shot accuracy alone.
claims.required_conditions: A future route/relocation/handoff opportunity mechanism is needed for full value; current conditional shot remains testable.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: An overall comparison favoring another actor is not reason to lower Curry shooting.
claims.missing_engine_context: Off-ball route creation/repeated relocation and teammate motion incomplete.

claims.expected_direction: Full post/hub offense cannot be measured by only guard-style drive/lob routes.
claims.required_conditions: Need post establishment/counters and continuation/short-roll/post pass contexts before whole creator interpretation.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: A poor narrow-probe ranking does not refute historic offense or justify lowering supported abilities.
claims.missing_engine_context: Post/hub and additional pass-family mechanism coverage incomplete.

claims.expected_direction: A roll-only screen probe cannot represent pick-and-pop spacing value.
claims.required_conditions: Stationary catch is testable; pop route must exist before screen-pop contribution can be compared.
claims.counterevidence_and_uncertainty: Pop=0 in a supported-context control is not evidence Turner never pops or is a bad roller.
claims.missing_engine_context: Pick-and-pop excluded from frozen mechanism; never rename pop F03.
